value.rationale: A natural two-input stability question for shape-constrained least squares has a complete qualitative classification under all positive observation masses and arbitrary knots, a nontrivial exceptional 3-site balance, a sharp first failure at 4 sites, and a quantitative family approaching 3/2. This isolates irreversible variation instability despite Hilbert nonexpansivity, without requiring a larger theorem.
